# Strova Group

> AI & automation for growing businesses.

Strova Group is an India-based technology and digital services firm delivering high-performance software engineering, native mobile apps, automated WhatsApp workflows, and data-driven marketing for local businesses in India and international clients worldwide.

## Divisions

- **Strova Technologies** (https://strovagroups.in/technologies/): High-performance static and hybrid web platforms (Astro, Next.js), native Android applications (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), custom SaaS dashboards, and official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API & AI automation pipelines.
- **Strova Digital** (https://strovagroups.in/digital/): Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals remediation, paid search & social media advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads) with server-side CAPI tracking, and B2B inbound lead generation funnels.
- **Strova Commerce** (https://strovagroups.in/commerce/): Headless e-commerce storefronts, conversational WhatsApp catalog checkouts, omnichannel inventory synchronization, and Cash-on-Delivery (COD) RTO fraud reduction engines (Launching Q3 2026).
